jobs.title: Campus Security Officer — Safeguard Students & Community
jobs.description:
Trinity Valley School in Fort Worth, Texas, is seeking a full-time Security Officer to join our dedicated safety team starting January 2024. The successful candidate will protect students, faculty, and visitors while upholding TVS values and the school's commitment to a secure learning environment.

Responsibilities include campus patrols, access control, camera monitoring, incident reporting, and assisting with drills and emergency response.
